column2: Then it happened a few more times... and the adults noticed my power...{wait}{clear}
The Church... was looking for someone with the healing hands, the mark of the Pope, so they took me in right away.{wait}{clear}
But all the Church had my hands do was treat nobles, royals and rich merchants who gave big donations...{wait}{clear}
Eventually I got tired of it, made up some excuse, and stopped using my power...{wait}{clear}
Because I refuse to be used by others...{wait}{clear}
...It's not like... I need it now... a power like this...{wait}{clear}......{wait}{clear}
It's snow...{wait}{clear}
No wonder it's so cold...{wait}{clear}
Let's go back to the inn...{wait}{clear}
Viper, you!{wait}{clear}
Ha ha ha ha, Rocus. You really are a soft touch.{wait}{clear}
...Be careful. Sometimes it's more than a scratch...{wait}{clear}
See ya. It was fun...{wait}{clear}
Do you have time, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I'm free.{wait}{clear}
Is the wound by your eye all right?{wait}{clear}
Yes, it's no problem. Just a scratch.{wait}{clear}
It left a scar, though...{wait}{clear}
Well, I'll keep it as a memento of our adventures.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄... I don't know about your other heroes, but...{wait}{clear}
I can't fight for the sake of others.{wait}{clear}
For me, doing that would be hypocrisy...{wait}{clear}
But... for the woman I love... the girl I love, I can do it...{wait}{clear}
I don't care what happens to this body...{wait}{clear}
I could do anything... I'm sure.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄... I love your smile...{wait}{clear}
Your hair, your gentle voice... I love everything about you.{wait}{clear}
I've... never asked a human woman this before, but...{wait}{clear}
May I kiss you?{wait}{clear}
Accept{n}
Refuse{n}
I love you...{wait}{clear}

Sigh...{wait}{clear}
Turning down a man like me... you'll probably regret it, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
What a deep forest. Surely nobody lives in a place like this...?{wait}{clear}
...Wait, is someone there...?{wait}{clear}
What have they done...{wait}{clear}The Heavenly Dragon... Did Endymion's blood call it here...?{wait}{clear}
I won't let you do as you please any longer!{wait}{clear}
The tower is collapsing, Rocus!{wait}{clear}

Rocus the hero, and ＄＄＄＄＄＄ the angel, you have done well.{wait}{clear}
